hints.title: Stirling Numbers of the Second Kind
hints.text: Distributing n distinct candies into k identical non-empty bags corresponds to Stirling numbers of the second kind S(n, k).

hints.title: Recurrence Relation
hints.text: For the n-th candy, either place it into a newly created bag (S(n - 1, k - 1)) or place it into any of the k existing bags (k * S(n - 1, k)).

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic and Space Optimization
hints.text: S(n, k) = (S(n - 1, k - 1) + k * S(n - 1, k)) modulo 10^9 + 7. Maintain an array of size k + 1 for O(k) memory.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Computes Stirling numbers iteratively using rolling 1D state array.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching without memoization has exponential complexity O(K^N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Rolling 1D array reduces space from O(N * K) to O(K).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizing Stirling numbers of the second kind with DP space optimization.
